clue.text: Greek descendant of farm animal discovered in vast geological age

indicators.note: something discovered in a place is found inside it, so the animal sits within the age

parts.note: an eon is the largest division of geological time
a pig is a farmyard animal

explanation.surface: A natural-history riddle: a pig found buried in the rocks of some immense prehistoric era.
explanation.walkthrough: The Epigoni were the sons of the Seven against Thebes, who avenged their fathers; the word came to mean any successor or lesser follower.
explanation.definitionFit: The Epigoni of Greek legend were the offspring of earlier heroes, so one of them is a Greek successor.

clue.text: Pastor worked up about the French heavenly guide

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go round the French article
being worked up suggests agitation, so the letters of the clergyman are stirred into a new order

parts.note: le is French for 'the'

explanation.surface: An excitable minister gets agitated about the French, while also pointing the way to heaven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worked up' makes the anagram POSTAR, and 'about' puts it around the article.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pole Star sits almost over the North Pole, so navigators have long steered by it as a guide in the sky.

clue.text: Sell last pieces of fine Japanese silver? He would.

definitions.text: Sell last pieces of fine Japanese silver? He would.

parts.note: to auction something is to sell it to the highest bidder

indicators.note: the final letters of each of the next three words are taken

explanation.surface: Someone is offloading the remnants of a collection of fine Japanese silverware: who would do that? The answer names him.
explanation.walkthrough: A semi all-in-one: the whole clue describes the person, while the wordplay adds E, E and R, the final letters of 'fine', 'Japanese' and 'silver', to a verb meaning sell.
explanation.definitionFit: The person who sells lots, such as remaining pieces of a silver collection, at a sale by bidding is the one who conducts it.

clue.text: Country-loving group second to get cut off following father

indicators.note: the group and the shortened second come after father

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
a trio is a group of three

indicators.note: a word that gets cut off loses its final letter

parts.note: a tick is a moment, an informal word for a second

explanation.surface: A band's second member is fired after Dad intervenes, all in a song about loving one's country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get cut off' removes the last letter of TICK, leaving TIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who loves their nation and is devoted to it is described with this adjective.

clue.text: Island surrounding church freezes over

indicators.note: the island abbreviation goes round the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A wintry scene: the sea around an island with a church on it turns solid with cold.
explanation.definitionFit: When water freezes over it forms a layer of frozen crust, which is what the verb in its intransitive use describes.

clue.text: Backing for railway track

definitions.meaning: taking a side in an argument is supporting or backing it
a short length of track beside the main line where trains are parked or shunted

explanation.surface: Someone giving support to a campaign for a new rail line.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both taking someone's part in a dispute and a short branch line off the main railway.

clue.text: Bond bird hit fellow getting uppity?

parts.note: ree is a variant spelling of reeve, the female ruff, a wading bird

indicators.note: in a down clue, getting up means reading upwards, so these words are turned backwards

parts.note: tonk is a British informal word for hit hard

explanation.surface: A bird strikes a man who is getting above himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting uppity' turns TONK and F upwards into FKNOT. TONK is British slang for striking a ball hard, as in cricket. 'Bond' is a knot that binds, not James Bond.
explanation.definitionFit: A reef knot is a secure tie used to join two rope ends, a kind of binding.

clue.text: Abundant enjoyment mostly found in writing

indicators.note: the shortened enjoyment is located inside the writing

parts.note: prose is ordinary written language

indicators.note: mostly means all but the last letter

parts.note: fun is enjoyment

explanation.surface: A reader takes plentiful pleasure from a good piece of writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the last letter of the enjoyment word before it goes into the writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something profuse is plentiful and pours out in large amounts, the same sense as abundant.

clue.text: PM's idea of paradise

definitions.meaning: Anthony ... was the British Prime Minister from 1955 to 1957
the garden of Adam and Eve in Genesis is the model of a perfect place

explanation.surface: A prime minister's notion of heaven on earth.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', joining the two definitions. Anthony Eden was a British Prime Minister in the 1950s.
explanation.definitionFit: The surname of a postwar Prime Minister is also the biblical garden, a byword for any perfect place.

clue.text: In March I verified data store

indicators.note: the answer is found in the run of letters of the following words

explanation.surface: An office worker in March confirmed the records held on file.
explanation.definitionFit: An archive is a collection of records kept for reference, a place where information is stored.

clue.text: Outstanding support for group of stars

parts.note: great means excellent or outstanding
to bear is to carry or support

explanation.surface: A fan's excellent backing for a band of celebrities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'group of stars' looks like celebrities or a band; it is a constellation.
explanation.definitionFit: The Great Bear, Ursa Major, is a constellation of the northern sky containing the Plough.

clue.text: Small disagreement can be tiring

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
a tiff is a minor quarrel

explanation.surface: Even a minor quarrel can be exhausting.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiff walk or task is a demanding one that leaves you exhausted.

clue.text: Fool runs over explosive

parts.note: a nit is a silly person
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over

explanation.surface: An idiot hurries past a bomb.
explanation.definitionFit: Nitro is short for nitroglycerine, a powerful blasting liquid.

clue.text: Figure duck disturbed cat and left shortly

parts.note: a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so the letter O

indicators.note: disturbed means stirred up, so the letters of the animal are rearranged
shortly means the word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: gone means having left

explanation.surface: A duck upset the cat and quickly departed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' makes CTA from CAT; 'shortly' cuts GONE to GON. 'duck' is the zero score in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: An octagon is a geometric shape with eight sides, a plane figure.

clue.text: Passing over crossing initially is very easy

parts.note: transit is passage across or through

indicators.note: the first letter of each of the following words is taken

explanation.surface: A traffic remark: getting past at the crossing is a breeze.
explanation.walkthrough: A transitive verb passes its action over to an object; the word comes from Latin for 'go across'.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar, a verb of this kind carries its action across to a direct object, from the Latin for going over.

clue.text: Gas turbine machine with black top

indicators.note: in a down clue the black word sits on top of the machine

parts.note: jet is a deep glossy black
an engine is a machine that produces power

explanation.surface: Describing a dark-topped gas turbine.
explanation.definitionFit: A jet engine is a turbine burning fuel to drive hot gases out of the rear for thrust.

clue.text: Mistakenly be inane about the setter during passage in book

indicators.note: during places the built letters inside the passage word

parts.note: the throat is the passage from mouth to stomach

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go round the setter's pronoun
mistakenly suggests the letters are put in the wrong order

parts.note: a setter refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: A confession: the setter, while writing a passage in a book, got things wrong in a silly way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mistakenly' rearranges the fodder to EENINAB; 'about' and 'during' both signal placing inside. The book is Jerome K. Jerome's comic boating novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Jerome K. Jerome's comic novel of 1889 about a boating holiday on the Thames is this title.

clue.text: Hospital men in Texas remodelled chests

indicators.note: the hospital and the men are placed in the rearranged state
remodelled means rebuilt in a new form, so the letters of the state are rearranged

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital
OR, other ranks, means soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: Hospital staff in Texas have been reorganised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'remodelled' shuffles the state's letters to TAXES, and 'in' signals the insertion. 'Men' are the other ranks, soldiers below officer rank.
explanation.definitionFit: The thorax is the part of the body between neck and abdomen, the chest.

clue.text: Bullish idiot producing contradiction in terms

parts.note: oxy, like an ox, is a playful adjective for bull-like
a moron is a fool

explanation.surface: An aggressive fool says something self-contradictory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bullish' looks like optimistic; here it means ox-like.
explanation.definitionFit: A figure of speech pairing opposite terms, such as 'deafening silence', is this kind of phrase.

clue.text: Comply with old British deal

parts.note: to serve cards or food is to deal them out

explanation.surface: A firm agrees to an old British trade agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: To observe a rule is to follow or keep it, which is complying with it.

clue.text: Use special 23 for feast

parts.note: the answer to 23 down, a word for study

explanation.surface: A cross-reference instruction: apply a particular answer to produce a banquet.
explanation.definitionFit: A spread is an informal word for a large meal laid out on the table.

clue.text: Manner adopted by lusty leader

indicators.note: the answer is taken into the following words, so it is found inside them

explanation.surface: A way of behaving taken up by a lusty chief.
explanation.definitionFit: A style is a way of doing something, its manner or mode.

clue.text: He-men's tangle? Exactly!

indicators.note: a tangle is a mess, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Muscle men getting into a mess with each other: precisely what happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tangle' does double duty, as the anagram signal and as the meaning, so the whole clue describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To entangle something as in a net is what the verb means, so a tangle of brawny men catches them together.

clue.text: Study of grass in report

indicators.note: a report is what is heard, so the word for grass is said out

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass of wet ground

explanation.surface: A research report on a variety of grass.
explanation.definitionFit: To read a subject at university is to study it, a British usage.

clue.text: Nameless rancid mixture is pungent

indicators.note: a mixture stirs things together, so the remaining letters are rearranged
nameless means without N, the abbreviation for name

explanation.surface: An unidentified rotten concoction smells strong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nameless' takes N from RANCID, leaving RACID, and 'mixture' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Acrid means sharp and bitter in smell or taste, which is strong and pungent.

clue.text: Irish assembly's ideal is shattered after European withdrawal

indicators.note: shattered means broken into pieces, so the remaining letters are rearranged
with E, for European, withdrawn from the word

explanation.surface: An Irish parliament's ideal is broken after leaving Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after European withdrawal' takes E from IDEAL, leaving IDAL, which 'is shattered' rearranges. The 's means 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dail is the lower house of the Irish parliament, the Oireachtas.

clue.text: Announced supposed space for visitor accommodation

indicators.note: announced means said out, so the word for supposed is heard

parts.note: guessed means supposed
room means space

explanation.surface: A declaration about a supposed area set aside for guests.
explanation.definitionFit: A spare bedroom kept for people staying over is where visitors are put up.

clue.text: Girl starts to smile impishly about excuse

parts.note: Eva is a girl's name

indicators.note: the first letters of the following two words are taken

parts.note: on means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A girl begins to grin mischievously while making excuses.
explanation.definitionFit: An evasion is a dodge or pretext used to avoid something, like an excuse.

clue.text: Crafty journalist returned acknowledgements of debt after third of November

indicators.note: the debts come after the third letter
returned means sent back, so the letters are reversed

parts.note: ED is short for editor, a journalist

indicators.note: the third letter of the following word

parts.note: IOUs are written notes acknowledging money owed

explanation.surface: A cunning reporter came back with IOUs after the third of November.
explanation.definitionFit: Devious means scheming and underhand, the same as crafty.
